Note: Requirement #2: correlation between MDE ActionType values and standard Windows Event IDs / Sysmon events, scoped to the ActionTypes this module's fixtures and detection rules actually reference plus their immediate, well-established companions -- not an exhaustive enumeration of every ActionType MDE can emit, which numbers in the hundreds and is not independently verifiable from public documentation with confidence. Windows Security Event IDs and Sysmon Event IDs referenced here are stable, long-established values (Sysmon's ID scheme in particular has not changed since Sysmon v6), verified against current Microsoft/Sysinternals documentation and community references rather than assumed from training data.
